events.content: At the 2026-04-02 planning meeting I said that project Cedar reports should be distributed as PDF. Project Birch reports should remain plain text.

Correction to my Cedar note: I wrote PDF by mistake. The Cedar reports have actually required CSV since 2026-04-01. This is a correction of what I said on April 2, not a new format change today. The correction applies only to Cedar.
For Cedar, the CSV rule covers the weekly reports. I have not specified a format for Cedar incident reports. Birch still uses plain text.
